title: FBXO39 promotes LDHA-mediated aerobic glycolysis and colorectal cancer progression by p53 degradation.
authors: Liu, Jipeng; Xiao, Taifu; Huang, Jun
one_liner_zh: 该文研究FBXO39通过泛素化降解p53促进结直肠癌有氧糖酵解，核心是蛋白-蛋白互作与肿瘤代谢，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，且方法以湿实验为主，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Colorectal cancer (CRC) is one of the leading causes of cancer-related deaths worldwide. Ubiquitination modification is extensively involved in various biological processes, including aerobic glycolysis and tumor development. TP53 mutations are present in nearly half of CRC patients, while in p53-wild type CRC, effective therapeutic targets remain relatively limited. METHODS: We employed bioinformatics methods to systematically analyze the expression and prognostic value of E3 ubiquitin ligase FBXO family members in CRC, with a focus on FBXO39. Through in vitro experiments such as CCK-8 assay, EdU cell proliferation assay, colony formation assay, glucose metabolite measurement, oxygen consumption rate (OCR) and extracellular acidification rate (ECAR) analyses, as well as in vivo experiments including cell-derived xenograft models, we elucidated the biological functions of FBXO39 in CRC. Furthermore, we explored its molecular mechanisms through molecular docking, co-immunoprecipitation (Co-IP), and ubiquitination assays. RESULTS: FBXO39 expression was significantly higher in CRC tissues than in adjacent normal tissues, and its high expression was associated with poor patient prognosis. Functional experiments demonstrated that FBXO39 significantly promoted CRC cell proliferation both in vitro and in vivo. Mechanistically, FBXO39 directly bound to the p53 protein and promoted its ubiquitination-mediated degradation in p53-wild type CRC cells. Further investigations revealed that FBXO39 overexpression enhanced the aerobic glycolysis capacity of CRC cells, while its knockdown inhibited this process. Mechanistically, FBXO39 enhanced aerobic glycolysis and promoted tumor cell proliferation by upregulating lactate dehydrogenase A (LDHA) expression in a p53-dependent manner. CONCLUSION: This study reveals a novel mechanism for p53 protein downregulation in p53-wild type CRC, elucidates the role of FBXO39 in regulating aerobic glycolysis through the p53/LDHA axis to promote tumor progression, and provides new insights into the function of FBXO39 in metabolic reprogramming in CRC.
abstract_zh: 背景：结直肠癌（CRC）是全球癌症相关死亡的主要原因之一。泛素化修饰广泛参与多种生物过程，包括有氧糖酵解和肿瘤发展。TP53突变存在于近半数CRC患者中，而在p53野生型CRC中，有效的治疗靶点仍相对有限。方法：我们采用生物信息学方法系统分析了E3泛素连接酶FBXO家族成员在CRC中的表达及其预后价值，重点关注FBXO39。通过体外实验，如CCK-8实验、EdU细胞增殖实验、集落形成实验、葡萄糖代谢物测量、耗氧率（OCR）和细胞外酸化率（ECAR）分析，以及体内实验，包括细胞源性异种移植模型，我们阐明了FBXO39在CRC中的生物学功能。此外，我们通过分子对接、免疫共沉淀（Co-IP）和泛素化实验探讨了其分子机制。结果：FBXO39在CRC组织中的表达显著高于邻近正常组织，其高表达与患者预后不良相关。功能实验表明，FBXO39在体外和体内均显著促进CRC细胞增殖。机制上，FBXO39直接结合p53蛋白，并在p53野生型CRC细胞中促进其泛素化介导的降解。进一步研究发现，FBXO39过表达增强了CRC细胞的有氧糖酵解能力，而其敲低则抑制了这一过程。机制上，FBXO39通过以p53依赖性方式上调乳酸脱氢酶A（LDHA）表达，增强有氧糖酵解并促进肿瘤细胞增殖。结论：本研究揭示了p53野生型CRC中p53蛋白下调的新机制，阐明了FBXO39通过p53/LDHA轴调节有氧糖酵解以促进肿瘤进展的作用，并为FBXO39在CRC代谢重编程中的功能提供了新见解。
